name: SecureBio
summary: A Cambridge, Massachusetts nonprofit, formed in 2022, that works against catastrophic pandemics: the Nucleic Acid Observatory's untargeted metagenomic sequencing of sewage and airplane waste for early warning, evaluations of how far AI models help with dangerous biology (its Virology Capabilities Test is used by AI developers), and, until it passed to an independent Swiss foundation, SecureDNA's free DNA synthesis screening.
